description: Defines the CatalogItem class used as a data model for catalog items in the Blazor application, including validation logic and image handling methods.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog item with properties like Id, CatalogType, CatalogBrand, Name, Description, Price, and image data. Includes static methods for image validation and conversion.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates an image file based on its name and Base64 content, checking for presence, size, and extension.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Converts an uploaded file (IFileListEntry) to a Base64 string asynchronously.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks whether the file extension is one of the accepted image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
